o.uuid AS organization_uuid, w.uuid AS workspace_uuid, w.external_id AS workspace_external_id, u.uuid AS account_uuid, u.external_id AS account_external_id, fs.uuid AS filesystem_uuid, fs.external_id AS filesystem_external_id, COALESCE(o.settings->'org_taints', CAST('[]' AS jsonb)) AS org_taints_json, (NULLIF(trim(w.external_key_id), '') IS NOT NULL) AS workspace_cmek_enabled
mapper.update: SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock( hashtextextended( concat( 'filestore-provision', chr(58), CAST(#{workspaceUUID} AS text), chr(58), CAST(#{filesystemExternalID} AS text) ), 0 ) )
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM filestore_filesystems WHERE workspace_uuid = #{workspaceUUID} AND session_uuid = #{sessionUUID} AND deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO filestore_filesystems ( uuid, external_id, organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, session_uuid, code_session_uuid, created_by_api_key_uuid, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( COALESCE(#{params.FilesystemUUID}, gen_random_uuid()), #{params.FilesystemExternalID}, #{params.OrganizationUUID}, #{params.WorkspaceUUID}, #{params.SessionUUID}, #{params.CodeSessionUUID}, #{params.CreatedByAPIKeyUUID}, #{params.Now}, #{params.Now} ) RETURNING
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM sessions s JOIN organizations o ON o.uuid = s.organization_uuid JOIN workspaces w ON w.uuid = s.workspace_uuid AND w.organization_uuid = s.organization_uuid JOIN api_keys ak ON ak.uuid = s.created_by_api_key_uuid AND ak.workspace_uuid = s.workspace_uuid JOIN users u ON u.uuid = ak.created_by_user_uuid AND u.organization_uuid = o.uuid AND u.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN filestore_filesystems fs ON fs.organization_uuid = o.uuid AND fs.workspace_uuid = w.uuid AND fs.session_uuid = s.uuid AND fs.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE s.workspace_uuid = #{workspaceUUID} AND s.external_id = #{sessionExternalID} AND s.status <> 'terminated' AND s.archived_at IS NULL AND s.deleted_at IS NULL AND w.archived_at IS NULL LIMIT 1

WITH inserted_filesystem AS ( INSERT INTO filestore_filesystems ( external_id, organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, session_uuid, code_session_uuid, created_by_api_key_uuid, created_at, updated_at ) SELECT #{params.FilesystemExternalID}, w.organization_uuid, w.uuid, #{params.SessionUUID}, NULL, ak.uuid, #{params.CreatedAt}, #{params.CreatedAt} FROM workspaces w JOIN api_keys ak ON ak.uuid = #{params.CreatedByAPIKeyUUID} AND ak.workspace_uuid = w.uuid WHERE w.uuid = #{params.WorkspaceUUID} AND w.organization_uuid = #{params.OrganizationUUID} AND w.archived_at IS NULL ON CONFLICT ON CONSTRAINT filestore_filesystems_workspace_uuid_external_id_key DO NOTHING RETURNING uuid, external_id, organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, session_uuid, code_session_uuid, created_by_api_key_uuid, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at ) SELECT
FROM inserted_filesystem
